text: At 18', Westport Albion’s moment of increased control is characterized by 7 final third entries in 8 minutes, demonstrating an intentional direct vertical passing approach to penetrate Kingsmoor FC’s wide, crossing-based 4-4-2 defensive shape. Their PPDA of 7.2 versus Kingsmoor’s 12.0 confirms effective pressing higher up the pitch, serving as a pressing trigger to regain possession quickly and enable rapid transitions. Despite trailing 0-2, their 82.2% pass accuracy combined with a 55.2% field tilt signals sustained progression and rest-defence exploitation to destabilize Kingsmoor’s formation. The single off-target shot by Rafael Delacroix (xG 0.14) reflects vertical penetration rather than wide overloads, consistent with Westport Albion’s tactical mechanism to bypass the opposition’s flanks and create central threats.
